searches.ai_instructions: Focus on new features and pricing; skip tutorials.

runs.summary:
Two announcements stand out this week: a longer maximum run time for functions and cheaper Arm pricing in more Regions. Several posts compare cold starts across runtimes.
• Functions may now run longer for batch work [1]
• Arm (Graviton) pricing drops in three more Regions [2, 3]
• A benchmark of cold starts in Python, Node.js and Java [4]
